title: Test for Hydrogen Gas
subject: Chemistry
steps: Place zinc granules in the test tube.
Pour dilute hydrochloric acid over zinc.
Quickly fit the stopper with delivery tube.
Bring burning match near the mouth of the tube to test the gas.
correct_outcome: Pop sound confirms the presence of hydrogen gas (H2).

common_mistakes.explanation: Excess acid leads to vigorous reaction and possible splashing. Always add acid slowly.
Attempting the test before enough gas is collected can produce a small explosion and cause splattering.

safety_notes: Never face the mouth of the test tube towards yourself or anyone.

ai_explanations.pop_sound: Hydrogen burns in air with a pop sound. This confirms its presence after the reaction.
ai_explanations.vigorous_reaction: Excess acid or poor handling can lead to accidents. Always handle acids and gases with care.
